snippet.title: Micropede Game (1994)
snippet.description:
Micropede is a fast arcade game where you need to stop the micropede from reaching the bottom of the screen. Enemies such as spiders and other creatures will try to stop you as well.

Download at: http://doscollection.com/micropede/ 

The overall goal of the game is very simple and that is to destroy the micropede before it gets to the bottom of the level. There are also a variety of other enemies that will try and attack you such as beetles, spiders, mosquitos and much more. 

Every time the micropede hits the edge of the screen or a mushroom it will go down one level. So it there are a lot of mushrooms on the screen the micropede will be able to traverse down faster putting pressure on you to destroy it.

This game is action packed and a lot of fun well worth checking out again if you have the time.
